scope: Theorem 1.2 (The sharp entropy bound) of the manuscript “A sharp entropy bound and the simplex inequality for isotropic constants” (preprints/A-sharp-entropy-bound-and-the-simplex-inequality-for-isotropic-constants-October-5-2026/isotropic-simplex.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 101 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b6cb0115cd04d4eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let m ≥ 1 and let f be a log-concave probability density on Rm. Then h(f) ≥ m + 1 2 log det Cov(f). (1.4) Equality holds if and only if f is, almost everywhere, the density of M(E1, . . . , Em)T + b, where M is an invertible real m × m matrix, b ∈ Rm, and the Ei are independent random variables with density e−u1{u≥0}.
